immutable_no_tuning_rule: Never revise model, maps, label count, quantizer, outcome prefix or endpoints after target evaluation. All results must be reported.
author_decision: Final confirmatory attempt; one predetermined target evaluation; stop afterwards, including if risk method loses.
training_control: Late C4 development NLL per block, 32 blocks
training_observations: 30 complete 14-of-28 Qwen group allocations scored on 32 blocks; blockwise outcomes are available for every policy, no test outcome enters fitting

model.quantizer: symmetric RTN per-output-row 4/8-bit dequantized to fp16; biases unchanged; all 28 attention Q/K/V/O groups upgraded as whole groups

target_corpus.text_assembly: nonempty strip texts joined with two newline separators; add_special_tokens=False
target_corpus.loss: mean autoregressive cross entropy on 1023 predictions per block
target_corpus.note: WikiText test is a new corpus; first 64 token blocks are predeclared. This is not a claim of document-level independence between WikiText articles.
target_corpus.limitation: Disjoint token blocks within previously used WikiText-2 test split; not guaranteed distinct documents. Target split was chosen after historical prefix 0-63 was seen.

bit_allocation.backend: symmetric per-output-row RTN simulated FP16 dequantized weights
bit_allocation.equal_budget_applies_to: all 7 maps including Late; no packed kernel claim

algorithm.name: RiskCVaR_30 (experimental research proposal, not established algorithmic novelty)
algorithm.features: 28 attention group indicators; 32 block-level Δ NLL targets relative to Late
algorithm.risk_model: Ridge(alpha=1.0, unpenalized intercept) jointly fit to 32 blockwise targets using 30 development maps
algorithm.objective: minimize mean_t predicted delta_NLL_t(x) + 0.5 * CVaR_0.75({predicted delta_NLL_t(x)}) for exactly 14 of 28 groups
algorithm.cvar_linearization: min_{x,eta,u>=0} mean_t(A_t+B_t x) + λ [eta + (1/((1-τ)T))sum_t u_t], u_t + eta >= A_t+B_t x, eta free
algorithm.caveat: The method was designed after examining previous test results; this is only a prospective evaluation of fixed maps on a fresh token segment, not a full independent method invention.

baselines.Ridge01_30: Ridge(alpha=0.1), same original 30 C4 configurations; reproduces original freeze
baselines.OLS_30_CASQ_family: Unregularized additive OLS; simplified CASQ-family comparator, NOT faithful CASQ
baselines.LassoCV_30: LassoCV 5-fold training-only CV, 100 alpha grid, seed=20261020; sklearn version pinned
baselines.BestDevR21_30: lowest mean C4 development NLL among 30 paid maps (R21)
baselines.BlockRidgeMean_30: risk method ablation with λ=0 (same blockwise Ridge model, 30 paid maps)
baselines.Late_30: fixed 14 deepest attention-group upgrade as matched-budget reference and tail-difference baseline

target_tokenization: model-pinned tokenizer; concatenate stripped nonempty WikiText-2 test lines with two newlines, no special tokens; 64 non-overlapping 1024-token segments from block 64; hash before any policy outcomes

outcomes.mean_nll: arithmetic mean of 64 block-level mean next-token cross-entropy losses; 1023 positions per block
outcomes.tail_risk: empirical CVaR_0.75 of paired block-level NLL difference (policy minus Late) on the 64 fresh blocks
outcomes.bootstrap: 5000 moving-block circular resamples of 8 blocks (seed 20261020); descriptive only, serial dependence and document dependence possible

primary_decision_rule.objective: Is the new risk algorithm superior to the two strongest same-label additive competitors on this exact frozen target portion?
primary_decision_rule.risk_vs_Ridge01_BestDev: Secondary descriptive comparisons; report even if primary rule fails

secondary_decision_rule.metric: empirical CVaR_0.75 of block NLL differences vs Late
secondary_decision_rule.interpretation: Exploratory risk objective; compare every component at equal paid 30 map labels

non_claims: Not a faithful complete reproduction of CASQ
Not a statistically established cross-model advantage
No hardware packed kernels or physical speedups
No new GPU results at freeze time
sha_rule: sha256 canonical sorted-keys compact JSON UTF-8 excluding manifest_sha256
